prompt:
Study the 2023 Vistra disclosure as a public-source generator exposure case. The source states Odessa's December31,2023 net capacity and gives fleet-level hedging disclosures and an assumed7.2 MMBtu/MWh spark-spread sensitivity convention. The issuer PDF's historical publication time has not been established; its observed public availability is in2026 and this case uses an October4,2026 23:59:59 UTC observation cutoff. It does not claim a contemporaneous2024 trading replay. The SEC index separately establishes the 2023 Form10-K filing date; fiscal year-end is not publication date.

ALL dispatch, prices, cost and hedge terms below are SYNTHETIC, not reported Odessa operations or actual Vistra trades. Use the disclosed Odessa net MW. In a120-hour block, assume80% availability, full net output while available, and no output otherwise. Apply7.2 MMBtu/MWh as a scenario convention, not measured plant efficiency. Power sold at the node earns$65/MWh. Gas hub price is$3/MMBtu and delivered-gas basis is+$0.50/MMBtu. Variable O&M is$3/MWh. Ignore start-up, no-load, fixed, transport-other-than-basis, emissions, taxes, collateral, credit and transaction costs.

Separately, a purely financial hub-power swap covers600 MW in every one of the120 hours, receiving fixed$60/MWh and paying floating hub settlement$68/MWh. It neither changes plant generation nor disappears during outages. Cash settlement is hedge MWh times(fixed minus floating). Calculate contribution margins and the two specified unit price sensitivities. For hub-power sensitivity, node power moves one-for-one with hub and gas is fixed. For gas-basis sensitivity, the power swap provides no gas hedge. Solve break-even delivered-gas basis with all other assumptions fixed.

Branch U withholds local gas basis; no alternative delivered-gas price is supplied. Determine whether a unique margin remains identifiable. Also judge whether the source's Texas natural-gas fleet hedge percentage identifies actual Odessa-specific hedge terms. Cite source-dependent capacity, heat-rate convention and portfolio scope; the purely synthetic hedge settlement and missing-basis judgment require no fabricated citation. Numeric non-integers should retain at least six decimals.

Node power sales minus delivered gas cost and variable O&M, before the financial hedge; ignore costs explicitly excluded in the prompt.
Cash settlement of the separate600 MW receive-fixed/pay-floating hub swap over all120 hours, regardless of plant availability.
Physical contribution margin plus financial hedge cash settlement; hedge is not additional generation or a second power sale.
Change in combined margin for a$1/MWh rise in hub power price when node power rises by the same amount, holding gas, volume and basis fixed.
Change in combined margin for a$1/MMBtu rise in delivered-gas basis with gas hub price, power prices, dispatch and power hedge fixed.
Gas basis over the$3/MMBtu hub price that makes total margin exactly zero, keeping every other scenario input fixed.
Branch U withholds gas basis and all local delivered-gas price information. Does the package still identify a unique total margin?
Can the disclosed Texas natural-gas fleet hedge percentage establish Odessa's actual hedge notional, strike, settlement index and hourly profile?
